title: DOS: Directional Object Separation in Text Embeddings for Multi-Object Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image models using a Vision Language Model (VLM) to measure the success rate and mixture rate of generated images from prompts containing pairs of objects that naturally belong to dissimilar backgrounds (e.g., a camel and a penguin).

Analyzing the LAION 400M dataset to calculate and compare the co-occurrence rates (using the Jaccard index) of object pairs with similar versus dissimilar natural backgrounds, as well as analyzing the distribution of noun chunk counts in the training captions.
